stem: Isaiah would like to add some detail to support the idea he has presented in sentence 14. Which sentence could BEST follow and provide support for sentence 14?

options.label: F
options.text: I'm thinking that the ride will be over soon.

options.label: G
options.text: It comes out of the tunnel really fast and heads straight up into the air.

options.label: H
options.text: The light of a beautiful day is welcome but nearly blinding after the darkness of the tunnel.

options.label: J
options.text: While I find adventure movies intriguing, this doesn’t feel intriguing at all.
